messages:
marta: Hey team — quick repro for an annoying dup-create with the Python async client when retries kick in. Happened in a sample app: we hit a read timeout and the server later processed the original POST and created a duplicate.

marta: Minimal repro (super small):
```python
async def create():
    async with RedwoodClient(api_key=\"${REDWOOD_API_KEY}\") as c:
        await c.create_resource({\"name\": \"widget\"})
```

marta: Observed flow: client raises a TimeoutError -> our retry layer retries the request -> server eventually processes the original and returns 201 -> duplicate resource.

alex: Do you have request headers / request-id for one of the dupes? Are we sending an idempotency-key by default anywhere?

marta: No idempotency key present in the outgoing request. This was a plain POST from the sample app. Default retry_policy is linear backoff, max_retries=4.

jordan: I repro'd locally. Root cause appears to be: we treat read timeouts as retriable and we replay the body for non-idempotent methods because we re-open the stream. For file/stream bodies this is impossible; for small json bodies we end up resending.

sam: Two things we should consider: 1) introduce an IdempotencyKey helper in the SDK to make it trivial for apps to opt in (and export a typed alias), 2) change default behavior to NOT auto-retry non-idempotent methods (POST) unless an idempotency key is supplied or user explicitly enables it.

alex: Agree on conservative defaults. Also make retry/backoff config more visible in quickstart docs + sample app. Proposed API sketch: 
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient, RetryConfig
client = RedwoodClient(..., retry_config=RetryConfig(on_methods=(\'GET\', \'PUT\'), allow_replay_non_idempotent=False))
# helper to generate keys (typed)
key = client.idempotency.make_key()  # -> str (NewType/Typed alias)
```

jordan: Implementation note: infra already logs a low-level request_id but that's not suitable for dedupe. We should add a canonical \"Idempotency-Key\" header that infra and Dedicated can use to deduplicate safely.

marta: I'll draft a short design doc + update the sample-app to show how to opt into idempotency. Also want typings for the helper (NewType(\"IdempotencyKey\", str)) so mypy catches misuse.

dev-bot: Issue created: #2107 — \"py-sdk: idempotency helper + safer default retries\" assigned to marta (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/2107)

sam: Happy to review. Also recommend adding an e2e test that simulates a delayed 201: server waits > client timeout then responds 201 — assert only one created resource.

marta: Perfect. I'll open a draft PR with design + sample app changes and tagging this thread. Thanks all :slightly_smiling_face: :rocket:
